modify.note: Booking questions can carry a fee: a field, or each option of a field, can have a price. Pricing is only offered for Number, Select, MultiSelect, Checkbox, Checkbox group and Radio group fields; the field dialog shows a price input (per option for option-based fields) only when the host has turned the price field on, labelled with the event's payment currency.

handlePayment adds the fees of the booker's paid answers (priced fields and selected priced options) to the event type's base price before creating or holding the payment; with no booking fields or no priced answers the amount is unchanged.
handleNewBooking now also passes the event type's booking fields and the booker's locale to handlePayment so the add-on fees can be worked out.

add_edges.label: booking questions editor with pricing
add_edges.note: The event type editor renders the FormBuilder for booking questions and turns on the price inputs for paid event types, passing the event type's payment currency.
